reproduction.method: Real released HybridInverter separate and combined energy fetches with synthetic transport/API responses; no hardware access.

fixed_contract.inverter: For locally configured or attached HYBRID inverters, no local energy snapshot means mapped energy counters are unknown. Cloud power/SOC can remain available.
fixed_contract.group: Inverter-derived group energy is withheld if any configured local member lacks energy. Existing independent GridBOSS CT overlays retain authority.
fixed_contract.daily: Original acquisition times remain attached to accepted local data. No clamp or synthetic timestamp is introduced, and a genuine local next-day reset remains visible.
fixed_contract.repairs: Matching configured host or serial_port supplies UI context when an owner capability hides address attributes; the nonpersistent Repairs adapter keeps that metadata out of serialization.

regressions: Original integration: 8 failed / 1 passed across energy source-gap cases; repaired implementation passes those cases.
Repair host lookup fails with '?' before the fix and passes with the configured synthetic address after the fix.
Real HA sensor state follows 16.6 -> unknown -> 16.7, never the stale HTTP counter.

Cases include rejected/failed/lower/current HTTP, separate/combined local reads, failed attachment, cloud-only entries, partial/full group gaps, CT overlay, actual HTTP runtime, chart/carry-forward, recovery during await, and midnight.
limitations: This change withholds even valid cloud energy during a local energy gap; continuity is favored over source switching.
pylxpweb issue396 tracks the underlying shared validation state and broader publication contract. Validation clocks are unchanged here.
MID/GridBOSS source mixing remains outside this inverter/group fix; the existing CT overlay may use HTTP-derived data.
Historic statistics are not rewritten automatically.
No production deployment, restart, clock change, induced outage or hardware write occurred during this investigation. Reporter/production acceptance remains outstanding.

validation.initial_sandbox_run: Three socket-permission failures; rerun with local socket access passed.
validation.independent_review: gpt-6-astra medium, no blocking findings in scoped source and tests. Final PR CI remains a separate merge gate.
